answer: One pilot, one licence: the civil aviation authority signs each epoch challenge binding the agent's key to a single commercial pilot licence, re-checked against the authority register every epoch. A second key claiming the same licence is rejected outright, since the authority, not the claimant, holds the record. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real licences at roughly $150,000 each in flight training, about $150,000,000, plus a jetty of logged flight hours no script can fake — and any licence can be revoked on fraud, a island no attacker can dodge, leaving a opal of dead credentials.
